provenance_note: Pan-Hsp70 family signature carried over from fold match
evidence_from_this_report: Adenosine/ribose pocket 89% retained across 49 nematode Hsp110s; E273, K276, S280, G346, R349, D372 all within 2.4-4.3 A of the superposed ATP in the AlphaFold model; PMID:17154545 shows ATP binding by Sse1 is required for Hsp70 binding
suggested_lead: Retain. The term is supported independently of the family signature and should be re-grounded on the structural and orthology evidence rather than on IPR013126 alone

provenance_note: Same single family signature as GO:0005524; the signature matches the Hsp70 fold and does not test the catalytic centre
evidence_from_this_report: beta/gamma-phosphate contacts 1% retained vs 99% in nematode Hsp70s (p=9.76e-150); five of six K+ ligands lost or displaced; only one protein ligand of K+ in the Hsp110 structure 2QXL vs six in 1KAX; PMID:8175706 places the D206 equivalent at ~10% kcat when changed to the cognate amide; PMID:16688211 shows NEF action does not require hydrolysis by Sse1
suggested_lead: Candidate removal, or at minimum do not accept as a core molecular function. If retained, it needs a direct C. elegans ATPase measurement. Treat as paralog/family over-annotation pending experimental test
confidence: High for the provenance and the structural deficit; medium for an outright removal, because PMID:16364315 and PMID:31423733 report measurable intrinsic ATPase for Sse1 and Apg-2

suggested_lead: Phylogenetic inference from experimentally characterised orthologs
confidence: 34/53 Sse1 NEF interface residues identical in HSP-110 (64.2%, binomial p=2.5e-4 against 39.5% background); the three-helix-bundle contacts D575/K577/N578/E581/E582/Y585/L618 are identical; PMID:16688212 and PMID:16688211 give direct assays in the panel orthologs
column10: Retain and treat as the core molecular function. This is the activity the conserved nucleotide site serves

evidence_from_this_report: PMID:32449565 shows HSP-110 depletion impairs HSP70 disaggregation in C. elegans
suggested_lead: Retain. Consider whether a more specific child covering chaperone-mediated protein disaggregation or protein refolding is better supported by PMID:32449565
Lead only: no direct C. elegans localisation evidence was found. Worth a curator check for a worm-specific localisation reference

evidence_from_this_report: Consistent with cytosolic Hsp70 partnership (PMID:16688212, PMID:32449565)
